unlisted_practices: Generating juxtaposed evidence class activation maps supporting contrasting classifications to mitigate algorithm aversion and technology dominance
Comparing CAM generation pipelines (single-model, dual-model, generative) against clinician consensus ground-truth masks

screen.reason: The study develops and benchmarks different technical pipelines to generate juxtaposed class activation maps (XAI) for vertebral fracture detection, comparing them to clinician ground-truth masks without evaluating a human-AI deployment practice.
